semiconductor_relevance: High — AOS specializes in sealing products that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: AOS develops and showcases sealing products designed for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, emphasizing their resistance to various liquids and low ion elution properties. Their products also demonstrate exceptional performance under plasma irradiation and high-temperature conditions, making them suitable for advanced semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Sealing products resistant to pure water and acidic solutions
Materials with low weight change under plasma irradiation
